{{Short description|French physicist (1942–2019)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=August 2020}}
'''Eugène Cremmer''' (7 February 1942, in [[Paris]] – 30 October 2019, in Paris{{citation needed|date=November 2019}}) was a French theoretical physicist. He was [[CNRS#Organisation|directeur de recherche]] at the [[CNRS]] working at the [[École Normale Supérieure]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Eugène CREMMER |url=http://www.phys.ens.fr/~cremmer/|publisher=Laboratoire de Physique Théorique de l'Ecole Normale Supérieure |accessdate=2 September 2010}}</ref> Cremmer was a postdoc at [[CERN]] from 1971–72.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2020-07-19|title=Eugène Cremmer: 1942-2019|url=https://cerncourier.com/a/eugene-cremmer-1942-2019/|access-date=2020-11-19|website=CERN Courier|language=en-GB}}</ref> In 1978, together with [[Bernard Julia]] and [[Joël Scherk]], he co-developed [[eleven-dimensional supergravity]] theory<ref name="sciam_98">Duff M J [http://www.nikhef.nl/pub/services/biblio/bib_KR/sciam14395569.pdf ''The Theory Formerly Known as Strings''], [[Scientific American]] Feb 1998, 64–69.</ref> and proposed a mechanism of spontaneous [[compactification (physics)|compactification]] in [[field theory (physics)|field theory]].<ref>E Cremmer, J Scherk: Spontaneous compactification of space in an Einstein-Yang-Mills-Higgs model - Nuclear Physics B, 1976</ref> He was also one of the first to write down the full [[4D N = 1 supergravity]] action in 1982.<ref name="Cremmer1">{{cite journal|last1=Cremmer|first1=E.|authorlink1=Eugène Cremmer|last2=Ferrara|first2=S.|authorlink2=Sergio Ferrara|last3=Girardello|first3=L.|authorlink3=|last4=Van Proeyen|first4=A.|authorlink4=|date=1983|title=Yang-Mills theories with local supersymmetry: Lagrangian, transformation laws and super-Higgs effect|url=https://dx.doi.org/10.1016/0550-3213%2883%2990679-X|journal=Nuclear Physics B|volume=212|issue=3|pages=413–442|doi=10.1016/0550-3213(83)90679-X|pmid=|arxiv=|bibcode=1983NuPhB.212..413C |s2cid=|access-date=|url-access=subscription}}</ref><ref name="Cremmer2">{{cite journal|last1=Cremmer|first1=E.|authorlink1=Eugène Cremmer|last2=Ferrara|first2=S.|authorlink2=Sergio Ferrara|last3=Girardello|first3=L.|authorlink3=|last4=Van Proeyen|first4=A.|authorlink4=|date=1982|title=Coupling supersymmetric Yang-Mills theories to supergravity|url=https://dx.doi.org/10.1016/0370-2693%2882%2990332-X|journal=Physics Letters B|volume=116|issue=4|pages=231–237|doi=10.1016/0370-2693(82)90332-X|pmid=|arxiv=|bibcode=1982PhLB..116..231C |s2cid=|access-date=|url-access=subscription}}</ref>
